result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**\. However, if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend Shopify Payments instead.

Assuming you're operating in the UK, here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for small businesses

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Competitive transaction fees.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent reporting and fraud prevention.

UK standard card rate: approximately 1.5% + 20p.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/gb/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- No separate third-party transaction surcharge.
- Supports multiple payment methods.

Fees depend on your Shopify subscription.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best additional payment option)

- Recognised and trusted by shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance.
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms.
- Can offer an alternative checkout option.

Usually more expensive than standard card processing.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Good for businesses selling online and in person.
- Straightforward setup.
- Online store and payment links available.
- Useful inventory and sales management.

UK online card rate approximately 1.4% + 25p.

[Square payments](https://squareup.com/gb/en/payments)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

- Particularly good for European customers.
- Supports multiple local payment methods.
- Transparent transaction-based pricing.
- Useful ecommerce integrations.

Worth considering if you sell across Europe.

[Mollie website](https://www.mollie.com/)

## My recommendation

For a typical small online store, I'd start with\:

- **Stripe** for accepting debit and credit cards.
- **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
- Apple Pay and Google Pay to make mobile checkout easier.

This gives customers several familiar ways to pay without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.

## Three questions to help me find the best option

The cheapest and best processor can vary considerably depending on your business.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**

Shopify

WooCommerce / WordPress

Wix

Custom-built website

Haven't built it yet

---

**2\. What monthly sales volume do you expect?**

Under £5,000

£5,000–£20,000

£20,000–£50,000

£50,000+

---

**3\. Where are most of your customers?**

Mostly UK

UK and Europe

Worldwide

Mostly US

---

**What do you sell?**

Physical products

Digital products

Subscriptions

Services

I can then compare the actual processing costs and recommend the most cost-effective setup rather than simply picking the most popular provider.
